items.title: How we're training a Figma-fluent editing model
items.excerpt: Figma explains how it fine-tuned a model on its native file format so the Figma agent can make fast, iterative design edits (spacing, color, layout rework) that frontier models handled poorly and expensively.

items.title: Make your Figma design system agent-ready
items.excerpt: Figma walkthrough on structuring a design system so the Figma agent can understand it and produce designs that look and feel like your product.

items.title: AI meets Apple's HIG: Redesign lessons and Liquid Glass
items.excerpt: A designer combines Apple's Human Interface Guidelines with AI tools in a real iOS redesign project, documenting how AI sped up the work and where HIG and Liquid Glass constraints shaped the outcome.

items.title: Designing for AI deep research: lessons from Google, Perplexity and Microsoft
items.excerpt: Six UX questions for designing long-running AI research tasks, drawn from how Google, Perplexity and Microsoft present deep-research agents.

items.title: The agent woke up before you did
items.excerpt: Argues that proactive AI agents shipped by four companies at once break the last assumption of user-centered design, that the user initiates the interaction.

items.title: Maxon teases another AI tool, and 3D artists aren't impressed
items.excerpt: Maxon teased a possible new AI tool for Cinema 4D, and the 3D artist community pushed back before any details were revealed.

items.title: New AI game engine wants NPCs to remember what you did
items.excerpt: Atelico's on-device AI engine gives game NPCs persistent memory, pitched as a toolkit that changes how games are played rather than replacing the people who make them.

items.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
items.excerpt: Developers direct frontier AI agents in natural language to assemble assets, wire physics and rendering with Omniverse libraries, and iterate on designs in simulation.

items.title: More mesh-to-CAD and a full stack of agentic EDA news
items.excerpt: CADFit, an open-source MIT/Siemens-backed tool, turns meshes into editable CAD code, alongside a wave of AI-agent announcements for electronics design.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz introduces AI-native backbone for product development
items.excerpt: Mercedes-Benz's PLM.AI aims to cut vehicle development time by 30% and halve physical testing while keeping existing quality and safety standards.

items.title: Snaptrude Agent launches for BIM workflows
items.excerpt: Snaptrude's new AI agent supports architectural workflows from concept design and BIM modelling through MEP and construction documentation.

items.title: Allplan Max delivers engineering AI across portfolio
items.excerpt: Allplan Max, a purpose-built engineering AI, is rolling out across Allplan's portfolio to automate repetitive design work and give expert guidance.

items.title: Autodesk Fusion October 2026 Update: 5 Features That Mean Less Rework
items.excerpt: The October Fusion update adds AI-assisted Auto Timeline that reconstructs imported geometry into editable parametric features, plus natural-language task management via Autodesk Assistant.

items.title: Apple Creator Studio adds powerful new AI features and even more creative tools
items.excerpt: Apple Creator Studio adds built-in MotionVFX content to Final Cut Pro, video assets in the Content Hub, and new intelligence features in Logic Pro, Keynote, Pages and Numbers.

items.title: Introducing Canva Brush, a vision-language model for design
items.excerpt: Canva Research's Brush, post-trained from an open-weights model on real design edits, now powers design edits in Canva AI for Pro users, up to 69% faster and 46% cheaper per edit than Canva's previous design agent. (Off-list: on-list outlets had not covered it.)

items.title: Runway Ads is generally available
items.excerpt: Runway Ads generates on-brand video and image ad variants from a brand kit, publishes approved variants to Meta, Google and TikTok and iterates on performance; now on all paid plans. (Off-list vendor source.)

items.title: These people are cutting the clutter and redesigning their smart TVs with AI
items.excerpt: Owners are using a handful of AI prompts to vibe-code replacement launchers that strip ads and recommendations from smart TV home screens, a grassroots UI redesign trend.
